$comment: The standards conformance map, machine-checked (tests/unit/test_conformance.py): a `conformant` row's evidence exists -- a test node id, or a CLI verb -- and the suite runs it; `partial` and `gap` say why; `non-goal` is a decided cut (cost exceeds benefit).

rows.clause: I codebase: build output is never tracked
rows.mechanism: each driver declares what its toolchain writes (`outputs`), a module adds its own (`modules.<id>.outputs`, never a removal); validate refuses every tracked file one matches, counted per output, with the `git rm -r --cached` and .gitignore fix
env files per environment; the injection contract STACK_KIT_ENV_FILE_<FOLDER>_<ENV>; one home per value
one archive per commit; a release is that archive plus the environment's config; run is compose up
health from the engine's status; rollback on a failed health; a restart is idempotent

one layout and one compose per environment; every deployable module, UI included, runs an image built from its driver's recipe -- the local stack builds the same recipe from the same release tree; remote dev runs the driver's dev image, not the release image
rows.why: the dev container is the toolchain's image with the source mounted, by design (hot reload); the release image is prod's

rows.mechanism: container logs, rotated (compose logging); `ops logs`
rows.why: logs go to the engine and rotate; no event-stream shipping is declared (the OTel collector template is the host's choice)

rows.mechanism: the manifest, the targets file and the catalogs declare the whole desired state
a release is an archive of a commit; releases/<commit> is never rewritten
deploy pushes from the CLI or CI
rows.why: no agent on the host pulls: the shared host runs no controller of ours; push with the same CLI is the decision

rows.mechanism: targets --verify reports drift read-only; the owning verb undoes it
rows.why: reconcile is cut by the owner: drift is reported, never auto-applied

rows.mechanism: release.json (commit, describe, dirty) in every archive; a provenance-less archive is refused
ci-gen attests each package with actions/attest-build-provenance
rows.why: signed only when built in CI; a local package carries unsigned provenance

rows.mechanism: anchore/sbom-action in the package job (spdx-json)
every action pinned by a full commit SHA
contents: read at the top; id-token/attestations only on package jobs
a release refuses `latest` or no tag; digests where requireDigests
rows.why: the kit's own driver images carry version tags; digests are the host's opt-in

rows.mechanism: VERSION is SemVer, the changelog names it
CHANGELOG.md, one section per release
rows.why: sections are by theme (Added, Removed, Migration), not every Keep-a-Changelog heading

rows.mechanism: type(scope): subject
rows.why: followed, not machine-checked: a commit hook is the host's

rows.mechanism: the kit's schemas
rows.why: they are draft-07, which the kit's own validator implements; moving costs a validator rewrite for no host benefit today

rows.mechanism: ADR-001 with numbered amendments
rows.why: context, decision, rejected alternatives -- not the MADR template headings

rows.mechanism: StrictHostKeyChecking=yes against the target's known_hosts; accept-new only when declared
BatchMode=yes first in every target's ssh options (a target declaring otherwise is refused); an identity is a key reference
hardened SPA nginx

rows.why: the separate live-parity job is not built

rows.clause: Build once; promote the same artifact through every environment
rows.mechanism: package builds a module's archive once (locally or in CI); deploy ships those bytes; the server builds only a thin runtime image, never compiling

rows.clause: Every release kept; rollback a pointer move, judged before it moves
rows.mechanism: releases/<commit> and `current`; a rollback (explicit or on failed health) never returns to a release that cannot run

rows.clause: Detect secrets in the tree and its history; never print them
rows.mechanism: scan secrets (tree and history); a known leak held by its value's fingerprint, never its key or a substring; a calibration document's specimens alone exempt; validate and deploy refuse

rows.clause: Generate secrets where they are used; least privilege on read
rows.mechanism: a generated key is made on the server once, never read back, handed to the uid its runtime runs as (0400), and checked to be read by the app's own code

rows.clause: 4.1 Run containers as a non-root user
rows.mechanism: every driver's release image runs as an unprivileged user and declares the uid its generated secrets are handed to

rows.clause: CICD-SEC-1 Insufficient flow control: no deploy before the scan
rows.mechanism: the generated CI's first deploy job needs the secret scan; later environments need the earlier deploy

rows.clause: Each module proved by its own tests
rows.mechanism: init declares commands.test-<module> beside commands.test, for agent-kit's areas to prove a change by its own module

rows.clause: Reference tables rendered from their sources and tested
rows.mechanism: help --markdown renders OPERATIONS.md's verb, driver and extension-point tables from the registry
